title: Search Tree Check
commonMistakes: Checking only each node against its immediate children
Allowing duplicates, which violate a strict binary search tree
Forgetting that values in a left subtree must be smaller than every ancestor, not just the parent
Returning false for an empty tree
followUps: How would you validate the tree with an in-order traversal instead?
What changes if duplicates are allowed on the right side?
How would you find the smallest subtree that violates the ordering?
attribution: Problem statement, explanation, and solutions by the Base Case contributors. Example and test provenance is under audit.
